notes.title: XP Update Part 2!
notes.content:
Greetings!

Today the XP Update Part 2  has released! Several changes are included like making the survival stat values visible on HUD, and the ability to gain multiple levels per run, but most importantly permanent stat buffs based on player level. 
During your run several factors are taken into account including distance traveled, entities encountered, and levels finished, which determine the amount of XP you gain each run. This has been adjusted to NOT scale with the total distance traveled anymore. At the beginning of each run you will be given a buff to your total Sanity, Stamina, H20, and hunger based on your player level.

The save select screen has also been adjusted to now display the player level, rather than the total distance traveled.

I want to thank everyone again for all of your support!

for any inquiries or suggestions feel free to reach out in the discussion forums!

-BaddWeather

notes.title: XP Update part 1!
notes.content:
XP Update Part 1 adds an XP system based on factors like distance traveled and entities encountered, as well as a leveling system specific to each save file. Player level will ultimately determine the rate at which stats drain, the max level for a stat, and how much experience is earned per run.

Issues regarding the accuracy of the distance counter have also been fixed, as well as several other minor bugs.

Part two is coming within a few days and will contain the rest of the features!

Thanks again everyone for all of your support!

-BaddWeather

notes.content:
[h1]Update #9:[/h1]

[h2]Level Select![/h2]

One of the final additions before the first phase of the full release is a Level Select screen. After reaching a new level of the backrooms ( and allowing the game to autosave) will unlock that level from the "Level Select" menu. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42238353/375a145a9e0d1a2f508c1070c1137a34183888d9.png[/img]

Level 1 and Level 2 both also feature 1 new entity each, with several more on the way. 

You'll also find interactive crates and boxes have been added to every level, which can be searched for basic items.

Thanks for all of the support so far!

-BaddWeather/Euclid Games

notes.title: Alpha 1.6 Item Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Update #8:[/h1]

[h2]Persistent Items![/h2]

The transition from Demo build to Full build has been divided into 3 major updates, Items, Entities, and Maps. I'm happy to announce a large portion of the planned items have been added to the game, and a rarity system has been assigned. "Common" items", like almond water, snacks, and sanity pills, will remain the same and are lost upon death. "Uncommon" items have been added, like energy drinks, and the fidget spinner, as well as "rare" items which will remain [i]mostly[/i] a secret. Uncommon and Rare Items will persist across death, meaning the player can accumulate and save these items over multiple playthroughs, increasing their chances of surviving longer in the Backrooms.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42238353/8969829f8a19f1a8e39cde77fc0c7bfb40300b54.jpg[/img]

The fidget spinner will dramatically reduce sanity loss while being spun.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42238353/72625a2181e74c5ee8351815910c6121c23e820b.jpg[/img]

The ear muffs are an equipable item that will prevent sanity loss from buzzing lights, but will also make it harder to hear entities.

Furthermore, many other issues have been patched in the latest update, including missing fonts for Russian and Ukrainian localization, menu fixes, and performance updates. Currently, I am looking for individuals who would be willing to help me translate the game accurately. Please reach out if you are interested! 

-BaddWeather/Euclid Games

notes.title: Alpha 1.4 and Demo Updates!
notes.content:
[h1]Update #7:[/h1]

[h2]Save Games and Localization![/h2]

With Steam Next Fest beginning in just a few days I have been working on the project non-stop. The full game is nearing completion, and the demo has reached a completed state.

You'll find that the 1.4 Alpha update is bringing several big changes to the full build, as well as the demo, including save game support and full localization for 7 languages!

As development has progressed, the addition of rogue-lite elements has gotten to the point I have decided to fully lean into this aspect of gameplay, and save games will now allow for the player to keep track of their progress. The goal for the player remains the same, to try and escape the Backrooms- however, the difficulty of doing so will be determined by how well the player can manage their resources over [i]multiple[/i] lives rather than one. Items like bedrolls, entity repellents,  and charms will be kept when the player dies. Stats like total distance travelled or time spent in the backrooms will contribute to permanent stat buffs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42238353/e4dcdcf7d2bab265afe34c1f6b7590e08502dd4f.jpg[/img]

Also, by request- The Backrooms: Found Footage, and its demo, are now available in 8 languages, including French, German, Italian, Ukranian, Spanish, and Russian!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42238353/d26224d0698e23b1bc9a550b528ff1d479644b89.jpg[/img]

Moving forward, more updates will be coming very soon as we approach Next Fest and then the Full Release on July 4th!

-BaddWeather/Euclid Games

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.6 Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Update #5:[/h1]

[h2]Mechanics and Lore[/h2]

[previewyoutube=I9YNAnL4sEw;full][/previewyoutube]

As many might have noticed, the trailer for The Backrooms: Found Footage dropped last week, and there were several developments revealed that I have yet to discuss in detail! The first round of entities are complete- this includes all of the strange and anomalous beings you may encounter during levels 0-2. The trailer revealed footage of the most dangerous one yet, the [b][i]Smiler.[/i][/b]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42238353/d6a6dfa6837f915dcdab59e1ec05d5c894a87e9b.jpg[/img]

Another apparent change is the visuals, which was to be expected. The main difference is the addition of volumetric fog, which certainly adds to the claustrophobia-inducing element of the Backrooms, and provides a more even distribution of lighting that an office space typically has. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42238353/b6a6ddc48472c6465862a57868f09f0f0c5cf037.jpg[/img]

The "madness effect" has been upgraded and is now much more intense while being less obstructive. The HUD has also been polished overall and madness and hydration, as of now, will be primarily managed by consuming different substances in the Backrooms- carpet water, and Almond Water being the main two at the moment. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42238353/c2940ebdf7a1f3fe1ab34e342dbaadd549c7c3a1.jpg[/img]

The plan as of now, is to release a demo by June 13th, the beginning of Steam Game Fest, with the full release following a few weeks after. Currently, the main game will include "Purist" and "Traditional" mode. These modes will be based on different lore, meaning they will differ in length, story, and entities. The demo will include "Purist" mode, with some minor adjustments as to include a few more features. 

Further updates will be posted in the upcoming weeks!

Support the project by adding it to your Wishlist!

[b]Euclid Games/BaddWeather[/b]

notes.title: Transition to Unreal 5
notes.content:
[h1]Update #3:[/h1]

[h2]Transition to Unreal 5[/h2]

While several core features were not functioning properly upon converting from Unreal Engine 5 Early Access to Full Release, these issues have been resolved and the game had been fully integrated into the full release of the engine. 

Taking this opportunity to clean up under the hood, I have also spotted several opportunities to expand the scope of the game overall, with minimal to no impact on the release date. The game will now include several game modes based on the accepted canons of the backrooms, this means more items, more maps, and more levels!

Support the project by adding it to your Wishlist!

[b]Euclid Games/BaddWeather[/b]

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=A-9MToxS0MU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Update #2:[/h1]

[h2]Character and Setting[/h2]

After finding a pipeline between Blender and Unreal, I tackled the task of programing a system that would could procedurally generate an infinite map. Thanks to many, many tutorials, I combined what I learned into something that finally worked.  I then turned my focus to the player character. There is now idle, walking, and running animations, as well as a VHS overlay with various states based on the characters sanity.  The next up date is coming later this week, and will feature updates on the first entity!

Further updates will be posted later in the week!

Support the project by adding it to your Wishlist!
